changes.newValue:
## Summary
- Added persisted first-time tutorial action tracking in AppController/AppControllerPersistence (`tutorial.actions_seen`) with helper API `show_tutorial_hint_once`.
- Added reusable tutorial hint text area scene (`TutorialHintArea`) and instanced it in Earth base, Earth launchpad, and asteroid preview scenes.
- Wired one-sentence first-time hints for key mechanics/actions: opening launchpad/control/satellite stations, opening New Mission, creating rocket, selecting target, launching from Earth, opening asteroid preview, mining, and return-home.
- Added Earth launch auto-route: 5 seconds after successful launch, set preview target + transition to asteroid preview scene automatically.
- Updated tutorial tests to validate first-time action persistence + non-repetition.

## Verification
- `Godot --headless --path scene -s tests/run_tutorial_tests.gd` ✅ (2/2 pass)
- `GODOT_USER_DIR=/tmp/godot Godot --headless --path scene --script res://tests/run_experience_tests.gd` ✅ (10/10 pass)
